_comment: Supplemental canonical Thai terminology. This file intentionally does not
duplicate every pilot, unit, weapon, series, or terrain catalog entry.
src/srw4/proven/catalogs.py merges pilot/unit names with these canonical terms
for ROM labels. tools/build_dialogue_reference.py builds the complete
rom-glossary.th.json contains only measured short-form display overrides.
Spellings follow how these series are read in Thai fan translation and official Thai media:
มาชินก้า not มาจินก้า, ชาร์ not ชะอะ, กันดั้ม not กันดามุ.
Katakana borrowed from foreign languages (English, German, French, Chinese, etc.)
are transliterated directly from the origin language / official English name,
Groups starting with _ are notes, not substitutions.
